Valid Driving License issued by the State Transport Authority

questions.explanation_english: The Directorate of Education (DoE), GNCTD, utilizes Aadhaar-based identification and verification across government, aided, and recognized private schools in compliance with the constitutional bench judgment of the Hon'ble Supreme Court of India (Justice K.S. Puttaswamy case). Although Section 15 of the RTE Act and Supreme Court rulings stipulate that lack of an Aadhaar card cannot be made a ground to deny initial admission to any child, schools are directed to obtain and link student Aadhaar numbers on the MIS portal (edudel). Aadhaar-seeded student IDs facilitate rigorous tracking of genuine physical attendance, prevent duplicate or fictitious ('ghost') admissions across government and municipal local body schools, and ensure leak-proof Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) of statutory welfare entitlements such as uniform allowances, textbook subsidies, and merit scholarships.

questions.question_english: A regular teacher in a Delhi Government school applies for 15 days of Commuted Leave on medical grounds. In accordance with Rule 30 of the Central Civil Services (CCS) (Leave) Rules, 1972, what is the mandatory prerequisite for sanctioning this leave?
options_english: Submission of a formal resolution and recommendation passed by the School Management Committee (SMC)
Mandatory debit of an equivalent number of days from the employee's accumulated Earned Leave account
Prior administrative sanction and formal approval directly from the Director of Education
Submission of a valid medical certificate issued by an Authorized Medical Attendant (AMA) or Registered Medical Practitioner (RMP)
questions.explanation_english: Under Rule 30(1) of the Central Civil Services (Leave) Rules, 1972, Commuted Leave not exceeding half the amount of Half Pay Leave (HPL) due may be granted on medical certificate to a government servant. The fundamental statutory condition for granting commuted leave is the production of a valid medical certificate issued by an Authorised Medical Attendant (AMA), a government medical officer, or a Registered Medical Practitioner (RMP) in the prescribed Form 3, along with a fitness certificate (Form 5) upon resumption of duty. When 15 days of commuted leave are sanctioned on medical certificate, twice that amount (i.e., 30 days) of Half Pay Leave is debited from the employee's HPL account balance, and the employee receives full pay and allowances for the 15 days. SMC resolution or Earned Leave surrender is not required.
questions.explanation_hindi: केंद्रीय सिविल सेवा (अवकाश) नियमावली, 1972 के नियम 30(1) के अनुसार, चिकित्सा आधार पर एक सरकारी कर्मचारी को उसके खाते में शेष अर्ध-वेतन अवकाश (Half Pay Leave - HPL) के आधे तक लघुकृत अवकाश (Commuted Leave) स्वीकृत किया जा सकता है। इस अवकाश की स्वीकृति हेतु अनिवार्य वैधानिक शर्त यह है कि कर्मचारी अधिकृत चिकित्सा परिचारक (AMA), सरकारी चिकित्सक अथवा पंजीकृत चिकित्सा व्यवसायी (RMP) द्वारा निर्धारित प्रपत्र (Form 3) में जारी चिकित्सा प्रमाण पत्र प्रस्तुत करे (तथा ड्यूटी पर लौटने पर फिटनेस प्रमाण पत्र दे)। 15 दिन का कम्यूटेड लीव स्वीकृत होने पर कर्मचारी के HPL खाते से दोगुने दिन (अर्थात 30 दिन का HPL) काटे जाते हैं और कर्मचारी को पूरे 15 दिनों का पूर्ण वेतन प्राप्त होता है। इसके लिए SMC की अनुशंसा या उपार्जित अवकाश की कटौती आवश्यक नहीं होती।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (D) Submitting medical certificate from AMA or Registered Medical Practitioner

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: Commuted Leave on medical grounds is granted under CCS Leave Rules upon submitting a valid medical certificate from an Authorised Medical Attendant or Registered Medical Practitioner. The leave sanctioning authority debits twice the period of commuted leave from the employee half pay leave account balance upon granting sanction.

questions.question_english:
Given below are two statements: one is labelled as Assertion (A) and the other is labelled as Reason (R).
Assertion (A): On the Government e-Marketplace (GeM) portal, a legally binding electronic contract is automatically generated once the buyer accepts the offer and places the supply order following L1 evaluation.
Reason (R): The GeM platform incorporates an automated payment gateway system that releases payments to vendors directly from the treasury, completely bypassing the financial sanction and approval of the Drawing and Disbursing Officer (DDO).
options_english: Both A and R are true, and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true, but R is not the correct explanation of A
A is true, but R is false
A is false, but R is true
questions.explanation_english:
Assertion (A) is true: Under GFR Rule 149 and GeM portal architecture, once a government buyer completes the procurement process (direct purchase, L1 comparison, or bidding) and places the order, the system automatically generates an electronic contract with a unique GeM Contract Number that binds both the buyer and the seller.
Reason (R) is false: GeM does NOT bypass the statutory financial approval or authority of the Drawing and Disbursing Officer (DDO). Payments for GeM orders are routed strictly through the Government Accounting System (PFMS / State Treasury / e-Challan / GeM Pool Account). The Consignee must first inspect the goods and generate a Consignee Receipt and Acceptance Certificate (CRAC) within 10 days of delivery. Only after CRAC generation and administrative verification does the DDO verify the bill, apply pre-audit checks, deduct TDS/GST, sanction the payment, and digitally authorize the disbursement to the vendor. Hence, Assertion (A) is true but Reason (R) is false.
questions.explanation_hindi:
अभिकथन (A) सही है: GFR 2017 के नियम 149 तथा GeM पोर्टल की कार्यप्रणाली के अनुसार, जब कोई सरकारी क्रेता GeM पर न्यूनतम बोलीदाता (L1) का चयन करके आपूर्ति आदेश देता है, तो सिस्टम स्वतः एक विशिष्ट अनुबंध संख्या के साथ डिजिटल अनुबंध (Electronic Contract) उत्पन्न करता है, जो क्रेता और विक्रेता दोनों के लिए विधिक रूप से बाध्यकारी होता है।
कारण (R) गलत है: GeM पोर्टल किसी भी स्थिति में आहरण एवं संवितरण अधिकारी (DDO) के वित्तीय नियंत्रण एवं अनुमोदन को दरकिनार (Bypass) नहीं करता है। GeM पर सामग्री प्राप्त होने के बाद परेषिती (Consignee) द्वारा भौतिक सत्यापन कर 'सामग्री रसीद एवं स्वीकृति प्रमाण पत्र' (CRAC) जारी किया जाता है। इसके पश्चात DDO बिल की जांच करता है, आयकर/जीएसटी की कटौती करता है और PFMS या राज्य कोष प्रणाली के माध्यम से विधिवत वित्तीय अनुमोदन प्रदान करने के बाद ही भुगतान जारी करता है। अतः अभिकथन (A) सही है, परंतु कारण (R) गलत है।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (C) A is true but R is false

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: The Government e-Marketplace automatically generates binding electronic contracts once an order is placed following lowest bid evaluations. However, GeM does not bypass the financial authority of the Drawing and Disbursing Officer, who remains responsible for verifying deliveries, approving payments, and releasing funds through official treasury channels.

questions.question_english: A Head of School wants to procure 20 desktop computers. As per GFR 2017, what is the mandatory procurement route if the items are available on it?
options_english: Open open-market tender
Local vendor quotation
Direct purchase from a branded showroom
Government e-Marketplace (GeM)
questions.explanation_english:
Under Rule 149 of the General Financial Rules (GFR) 2017, the Government e-Marketplace (GeM) has been made the mandatory online platform for public procurement of all common-use goods and services by all central government ministries, subordinate offices, and government schools.

Key Provisions of Rule 149 regarding GeM Procurement:
1. Mandatory Nature: Procurement of goods and services available on GeM is statutorily mandatory for all Government buyers. Traditional procurement routes (such as manual open market tenders or local quotations) cannot be adopted if the required product specifications are available on GeM, unless a specific non-availability certificate is obtained.
2. Procurement Thresholds on GeM:
   - Up to ₹25,000: Direct purchase permitted from any available seller on GeM meeting requisites.
   - Above ₹25,000 and up to ₹5,00,000: Purchase through GeM selecting the lowest price (L1) among at least three different manufacturers/suppliers offering identical specifications.
   - Above ₹5,00,000 (such as procuring 20 commercial desktop computers): Mandatory online bidding or reverse auction (RA) on the GeM portal.
3. Benefits: GeM ensures automated price transparency, competitive bidding, ease of vendor management, prompt payments to MSMEs, and zero physical discretion for institutional buyers.

Therefore, Government e-Marketplace (GeM) is the mandatory procurement route, making Option (D) the correct answer.
questions.explanation_hindi:
सामान्य वित्तीय नियम (GFR), 2017 के नियम 149 के अनुसार, सभी केंद्रीय मंत्रालयों, विभागों, संबद्ध कार्यालयों तथा सरकारी विद्यालयों द्वारा सामान्य उपयोग की वस्तुओं और सेवाओं की खरीद हेतु गवर्नमेंट ई-मार्केटप्लेस (GeM) पोर्टल का उपयोग वैधानिक रूप से अनिवार्य किया गया है।

नियम 149 (GeM खरीद) के प्रमुख विधिक प्रावधान:
1. अनिवार्यता: यदि कोई वस्तु या सेवा GeM पोर्टल पर उपलब्ध है, तो सरकारी खरीदारों के लिए GeM के माध्यम से ही खरीद करना अनिवार्य है। जब तक कि GeM पर अनुपलब्धता का प्रमाण पत्र न हो, तब तक पारंपरिक स्थानीय कोटेशन या समाचार पत्रों में खुली निविदा की अनुमति नहीं है।
2. GeM पर खरीद की वित्तीय सीमाएं:
   - ₹25,000 तक: गुणवत्ता और विनिर्देशों को पूरा करने वाले किसी भी विक्रेता से सीधे खरीद (Direct Purchase)।
   - ₹25,000 से अधिक और ₹5,00,000 तक: कम से कम तीन अलग-अलग निर्माताओं के उत्पादों की ऑनलाइन तुलना कर न्यूनतम मूल्य (L1) वाले विक्रेता से खरीद।
   - ₹5,00,000 से अधिक (जैसे 20 डेस्कटॉप कंप्यूटरों की खरीद): GeM पोर्टल पर ऑनलाइन खुली बोली (Online Bidding) या रिवर्स ऑक्शन (Reverse Auction - RA) आयोजित करना अनिवार्य है।
3. उद्देश्य: यह व्यवस्था खरीद में पूर्ण पारदर्शिता, मितव्ययिता, डिजिटल लेन-देन, बिचौलियों की समाप्ति और सार्वजनिक धन का सर्वोत्तम मूल्य (Value for Money) सुनिश्चित करती है।

अतः 20 कंप्यूटरों की खरीद हेतु अनिवार्य मार्ग गवर्नमेंट ई-मार्केटप्लेस (GeM) है, जिससे विकल्प (D) सही उत्तर है।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (D) Government e-Marketplace (GeM)

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: Under Rule 149 of General Financial Rules 2017, procurement of common-use goods and services available on the Government e-Marketplace is mandatory for government offices and schools. Direct purchase or bidding through GeM takes precedence over traditional market tenders, ensuring transparent digital transactions, competitive pricing, and efficient public procurement management.

questions.question_english: In school administration, which statutory register is specifically maintained in the school library to record the day-to-day borrowing, circulation, and return of books by students and staff members?
options_english: Accession Register
Issue Register
Stock Register
Catalog Register
questions.explanation_english:
In school library administration under the Directorate of Education (DoE) Delhi and Delhi School Education Act & Rules (DSEAR), 1973:

1. **Library Issue Register (Circulation Register)**: It is specifically maintained by the School Librarian / Teacher-in-Charge to document day-to-day book circulation. It tracks details including Student/Teacher Name, Admission Number/Employee ID, Class/Section, Book Title, Accession Number, Date of Issue, Due Date, Date of Return, Condition of Book upon return, and fine/overdue charges (if applicable).
2. **Distinction from other Library Records**:
   - **Accession Register**: The permanent, master record of every book acquired by the library in chronological order, containing details such as author, title, publisher, cost, source of procurement (contingency grant, library grant), call number, and withdrawal/condemnation status.
   - **Stock/Property Register**: Tracks non-consumable furniture and equipment in the library (bookshelves, reading tables, computers).
   - **Catalogue Register/Cards**: Organizes books alphabetically or by Dewey Decimal Classification (DDC) for indexing and location retrieval.
questions.explanation_hindi:
दिल्ली स्कूल शिक्षा अधिनियम एवं नियमावली (DSEAR), 1973 तथा दिल्ली शिक्षा निदेशालय के पुस्तकालय नियमों के अंतर्गत:

1. **निर्गम रजिस्टर (Issue/Circulation Register)**: यह रजिस्टर पुस्तकालय अध्यक्ष (लाइब्रेरियन) द्वारा विद्यार्थियों और अध्यापकों को पुस्तकों के दैनिक वितरण तथा उनकी वापसी का हिसाब रखने हेतु संधारित किया जाता है। इसमें छात्र/शिक्षक का नाम, दाखिला संख्या/कर्मचारी आईडी, कक्षा/विभाग, पुस्तक का नाम, एक्सेशन नंबर, निर्गमन की तिथि, वापसी की निर्धारित तिथि, वास्तविक वापसी तिथि तथा हस्ताक्षर दर्ज किए जाते हैं।
2. **अन्य पुस्तकालय अभिलेखों से अंतर**:
   - **परिग्रहण रजिस्टर (Accession Register)**: यह पुस्तकालय में खरीदी या दान में प्राप्त प्रत्येक पुस्तक का मुख्य स्थायी मास्टर रिकॉर्ड होता है, जिसमें पुस्तक का क्रय विवरण, मूल्य, प्रकाशक, विषय वर्गीकरण तथा अंतिम स्थिति (सक्रिय/राइट-ऑफ) दर्ज होती है।
   - **स्टॉक रजिस्टर**: पुस्तकालय के फर्नीचर, कंप्यूटर एवं अलमारियों जैसी अचल संपत्तियों का रिकॉर्ड रखता है।
   - **कैटलॉग**: पाठकों द्वारा पुस्तकों को विषय, लेखक या शीर्षक के आधार पर खोजने के लिए प्रयुक्त सूचीकरण व्यवस्था है।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (B) Issue Register

It records book titles, accession numbers, issue dates, borrower details, and return signatures, facilitating organized library inventory management and tracking issued reading materials effectively.

questions.question_english: Under the Central Civil Services (Leave) Rules, 1972, what is the maximum duration of Paternity Leave admissible to a male government servant having less than two surviving children?
options_english: 10 days
15 days
30 days
45 days
questions.explanation_english:
Under Rule 43-A of the Central Civil Services (Leave) Rules, 1972, comprehensive guidelines govern Paternity Leave for central government employees:
1. Eligibility and Duration: A male government servant (including an apprentice) with less than two surviving children may be granted Paternity Leave for a period of 15 days.
2. Admissibility Window: This leave may be availed during the confinement of his wife for childbirth, meaning it can be taken up to 15 days before delivery or up to six months from the date of delivery of the child.
3. Lapsing Provision: If Paternity Leave is not availed within six months from the date of delivery, it strictly lapses and cannot be carried forward or credited to any leave account.
4. Salary Entitlement: During the period of paternity leave, the government servant is paid leave salary equal to the pay drawn immediately before proceeding on leave.
5. Separate Account: Paternity leave is not debited against any other leave account (such as Earned Leave or Half Pay Leave) and may be combined with any other kind of regular leave.
6. Adoption Provision (Rule 43-AA): Paternity leave of 15 days is also admissible to a male employee with less than two surviving children who validly adopts a child below the age of one year.

These statutory rules apply to all male teachers and staff in Delhi Government and government-aided schools governed by DSEAR, 1973.
questions.explanation_hindi:
केंद्रीय सिविल सेवा (अवकाश) नियमावली, 1972 के नियम 43-A के तहत पुरुष सरकारी कर्मचारियों के लिए पितृत्व अवकाश (Paternity Leave) संबंधी प्रमुख प्रावधान निम्नलिखित हैं:
1. पात्रता एवं अवधि: दो से कम जीवित बच्चों वाले पुरुष सरकारी सेवक (प्रशिक्षु सहित) को 15 दिनों की अवधि के लिए पितृत्व अवकाश की पात्रता होती है।
2. अवकाश लेने की समयावधि: यह अवकाश पत्नी के प्रसव काल के दौरान, अर्थात प्रसव से 15 दिन पूर्व अथवा बच्चे के जन्म की तिथि से छह महीने की अवधि के भीतर लिया जा सकता है।
3. व्यपगत (Lapse) होने का नियम: यदि जन्म की तिथि से 6 माह के भीतर यह अवकाश नहीं लिया जाता है, तो यह स्वतः व्यपगत (lapse) हो जाता है और इसे आगे नहीं जोड़ा जा सकता।
4. पूर्ण वेतन का भुगतान: इस अवकाश अवधि के दौरान कर्मचारी को अवकाश पर जाने से ठीक पूर्व प्राप्त वेतन के बराबर पूरा अवकाश वेतन देय होता है।
5. पृथक खाता: पितृत्व अवकाश को कर्मचारी के किसी अन्य अवकाश खाते (जैसे अर्जित अवकाश या अर्ध-वेतन अवकाश) से काटा नहीं जाता है और इसे सामान्य अवकाशों के साथ जोड़ा जा सकता है।
6. दत्तक ग्रहण (Rule 43-AA): 1 वर्ष से कम आयु के बच्चे को वैध रूप से गोद लेने पर भी पुरुष कर्मचारी को 15 दिनों का पितृत्व अवकाश प्रदान किया जाता है।

दिल्ली स्कूल शिक्षा अधिनियम एवं नियमावली (DSEAR), 1973 के तहत दिल्ली सरकार तथा सहायता प्राप्त विद्यालयों के शिक्षकों एवं कर्मचारियों पर यह नियम पूरी तरह लागू होता है।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (B) 15 days

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: A male government employee with less than two surviving children is entitled to paternity leave for a period of fifteen days. This leave can be taken during the confinement of his wife or up to six months from the date of delivery for child care and supporting family responsibilities.

questions.question_english: Under the POCSO Act 2012, if a school staff member becomes aware of an offence under the Act and fails to report it, what is the maximum punishment prescribed for this omission?
options_english: Impositions of a substantial monetary fine only without jail term
Imprisonment up to 6 months or fine or both
Mandatory rigorous imprisonment for a period extending up to 2 years
Summary termination and immediate dismissal from service without inquiry
questions.explanation_english:
Under the Protection of Children from Sexual Offences (POCSO) Act, 2012, mandatory reporting of child sexual abuse offences is statutorily enforced under Section 19.

Section 21 prescribes the specific punishment for failure to report or record an offence:
1. Individual Failure to Report (Section 21(1)): Any person who fails to report the commission of an offence under Section 19(1) or Section 20, or who fails to supply such information, shall be punished with imprisonment of either description for a term which may extend to six months, or with fine, or with both.
2. In-charge/Institutional Head Liability (Section 21(2)): Any person being in-charge of any company or an institution (including schools, children's homes, or hostels) who fails to report an offence committed by an employee under their control shall be punished with imprisonment for a term which may extend to one year and shall also be liable to fine.
3. Departmental Consequences: In addition to criminal prosecution under Section 21 of the POCSO Act, DoE circulars and service rules mandate disciplinary proceedings under CCS (CCA) Rules, 1965 against delinquent school staff.

Therefore, for a school staff member who fails to report, the statutory maximum punishment is imprisonment up to 6 months, or fine, or both, making Option (B) the correct answer.

बाल यौन अपराध संरक्षण अधिनियम (POCSO Act), 2012 के अंतर्गत बच्चों के विरुद्ध होने वाले यौन अपराधों की अनिवार्य रिपोर्टिंग धारा 19 के तहत विधिक रूप से बाध्यकारी है।

धारा 21 में अपराध की सूचना देने या दर्ज करने में विफलता के लिए दंडात्मक प्रावधान किए गए हैं:
1. कर्मचारी/व्यक्तिगत विफलता (धारा 21(1)): कोई भी व्यक्ति (जिसमें शिक्षक, गैर-शैक्षणिक कर्मचारी आदि शामिल हैं), जो धारा 19(1) या धारा 20 के अधीन किसी अपराध की सूचना देने में विफल रहता है, उसे किसी एक अवधि के कारावास से, जिसकी अवधि छह (6) माह तक हो सकती है, या जुर्माने से, अथवा दोनों से दंडित किया जाएगा।
2. संस्था प्रमुख/प्रभारी का दायित्व (धारा 21(2)): विद्यालय या संस्थान का प्रभारी व्यक्ति जो अपने नियंत्रण में कार्यरत किसी कर्मचारी द्वारा किए गए अपराध की सूचना देने में विफल रहता है, उसे एक वर्ष तक के कारावास और जुर्माने से दंडित किया जाएगा।
3. प्रशासनिक कार्रवाई: आपराधिक दायित्व के अलावा, दिल्ली शिक्षा निदेशालय (DoE) के परिपत्रों के अनुसार ऐसे लापरवाह कर्मचारियों के विरुद्ध सीसीएस (सीसीए) नियमावली, 1965 के तहत तत्काल गंभीर अनुशासनात्मक कार्रवाई भी शुरू की जाती है।

अतः विद्यालयी कर्मचारी द्वारा सूचना न देने पर अधिकतम दंड 6 माह का कारावास या जुर्माना अथवा दोनों है, जिससे विकल्प (B) सही उत्तर है।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (B) Imprisonment up to 6 months or fine or both

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: Under Section 21 of the Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act 2012, any person including school staff who fails to report an offense committed against a child faces legal penalties. The statutory punishment for such deliberate non-reporting includes imprisonment for a period up to six months, a fine, or both.

questions.question_english: In the context of financial administration and budgetary control, what is meant by 'Re-appropriation'?
options_english: Transfer of funds between primary units of appropriation within the same voted grant
Surrendering unspent allocated budget funds directly to the Consolidated Fund
Securing additional budget allocations approved through a Supplementary Grant
Short-term borrowing of operational funds directly from a commercial bank
questions.explanation_english: Under Rule 2(x) and Rule 61 of the General Financial Rules (GFR 2017) and the Delegation of Financial Powers Rules (DFPR), 'Re-appropriation' is defined as the formal transfer of funds from one primary unit of appropriation to another within the same grant or appropriation. Re-appropriation enables departments and spending authorities (such as the Directorate of Education) to adjust savings that have accrued under one budgetary head to meet unforeseen, unavoidable, or enhanced expenditure under another head, without exceeding the total aggregate expenditure sanctioned by the legislature for that grant. Key statutory restrictions on re-appropriation include: (i) funds cannot be re-appropriated between different grants; (ii) funds cannot be transferred from Capital expenditure to Revenue expenditure; (iii) funds cannot be re-appropriated from 'Charged' to 'Voted' expenditure; and (iv) re-appropriation cannot be made for an entirely 'New Service' without legislative sanction.
questions.explanation_hindi: सामान्य वित्तीय नियमावली (GFR 2017) के नियम 2(x) तथा नियम 61 एवं वित्तीय शक्तियों के प्रत्यायोजन नियमावली (DFPR) के अनुसार, 'पुनर्विनियोग' (Re-appropriation) का अर्थ एक ही स्वीकृत अनुदान (Grant) या विनियोग के अंतर्गत एक प्राथमिक विनियोग इकाई (Unit of Appropriation) से किसी अन्य प्राथमिक इकाई में बचत की गई धनराशि का औपचारिक अंतरण (transfer) है। पुनर्विनियोग के माध्यम से प्रशासनिक विभाग (जैसे शिक्षा निदेशालय) विधानमंडल द्वारा स्वीकृत कुल बजट सीमा के भीतर रहते हुए, किसी एक मद में बची हुई राशि का उपयोग किसी अन्य आवश्यक मद में होने वाले अनिवार्य अथवा अप्रत्याशित व्यय को पूरा करने हेतु कर सकते हैं। पुनर्विनियोग पर सांविधिक प्रतिबंध: (1) दो भिन्न अनुदानों के मध्य पुनर्विनियोग नहीं किया जा सकता; (2) पूंजीगत व्यय शीर्ष से राजस्व व्यय शीर्ष में अंतरण प्रतिबंधित है; (3) 'भारित' व्यय से 'मतदेय' व्यय में राशि नहीं बदली जा सकती; तथा (4) बिना विधायी स्वीकृति के किसी 'नई सेवा' (New Service) हेतु पुनर्विनियोग नहीं किया जा सकता।

questions.question_english: According to Rule 18 of the Central Civil Services (CCS) (Conduct) Rules, 1964, a government servant belonging to Group 'A' or Group 'B' service (including School Principals and Vice-Principals) is required to submit a declaration/return of immovable property and assets. What is the prescribed frequency for submitting this return?
options_english: Monthly
Quarterly
Annually
Only upon retirement
questions.explanation_english: Under Rule 18(1)(ii) of the Central Civil Services (Conduct) Rules, 1964, every government servant belonging to any service or holding any post included in Group 'A' and Group 'B' (which includes Principals, Vice-Principals, and educational administrative officers in Directorate of Education and Kendriya Vidyalayas) must submit an Annual Immovable Property Return (AIPR) in the prescribed format. This return must give full particulars regarding the immovable property inherited by them or owned or acquired by them or held by them on lease or mortgage, as on the 1st January of each calendar year. It must be submitted annually by 31st January of that year. Submission of AIPR is also mandatory for vigilance clearance for promotions, empanelment, and deputation. Hence, the return must be submitted annually.
questions.explanation_hindi: केंद्रीय सिविल सेवा (आचरण) नियमावली, 1964 के नियम 18(1)(ii) के तहत, समूह 'क' (Group A) और समूह 'ख' (Group B) के पदों पर कार्यरत प्रत्येक सरकारी सेवक (जिसमें शिक्षा निदेशालय एवं केंद्रीय विद्यालयों के प्रधानाचार्य, उप-प्रधानाचार्य तथा अन्य प्रशासनिक अधिकारी शामिल हैं) को निर्धारित प्रपत्र में प्रतिवर्ष 'वार्षिक अचल संपत्ति विवरणी' (Annual Immovable Property Return - AIPR) प्रस्तुत करना अनिवार्य है। इसमें प्रत्येक वर्ष 1 जनवरी की स्थिति के अनुसार उनकी विरासत में मिली, खरीदी गई अथवा पट्टे पर ली गई अचल संपत्ति का पूरा ब्योरा दिया जाता है, जिसे 31 जनवरी तक ऑनलाइन/लिखित रूप में प्रस्तुत करना आवश्यक होता है। सतर्कता (Vigilance) क्लीयरेंस और पदोन्नति के लिए भी यह वार्षिक रिटर्न अनिवार्य शर्त है। अतः यह विवरणी वार्षिक रूप से दाखिल की जाती है।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (C) Annually

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: Central Civil Services Conduct Rules require government employees to submit an annual return disclosing details of immovable and movable assets and liabilities. Regular submission maintains public service transparency, allows monitoring of wealth accumulation relative to known income sources, and prevents official corruption across administrative departments and educational services.

questions.question_english: Under the Delhi School Education Rules (DSER), 1973, what is the maximum permissible period for suspension of a school employee by the Managing Committee of a recognized private school without the prior approval of the Director of Education?
options_english: 15 days
30 days
90 days
6 months
questions.explanation_english: Under Rule 115 of the Delhi School Education Rules (DSER), 1973, the Managing Committee of a recognized private school is vested with the power to suspend an employee where disciplinary proceedings against him are contemplated or pending. However, the rule explicitly provides that an order of suspension made by the Managing Committee shall cease to have effect after the expiry of 15 days from the date on which the order is made, unless it has been communicated to the Director of Education and prior approval thereof has been granted by the Director within those 15 days. If the Director does not accord explicit administrative approval within this statutory fifteen-day window, the suspension order automatically lapses, and the employee is deemed to have been reinstated with entitlement to full pay and allowances.
questions.explanation_hindi: दिल्ली स्कूल शिक्षा नियमावली (DSER), 1973 के नियम 115 (Rule 115) के अनुसार, किसी मान्यता प्राप्त निजी विद्यालय की प्रबंध समिति (Managing Committee) किसी कर्मचारी के विरुद्ध अनुशासनात्मक कार्रवाई विचाराधीन होने पर उसे निलंबित कर सकती है। किंतु इस नियम में स्पष्ट वैधानिक प्रतिबंध है कि प्रबंध समिति द्वारा जारी किया गया निलंबन आदेश, जारी होने की तिथि से 15 दिनों की समाप्ति के पश्चात स्वतः निष्प्रभावी (lapse) हो जाएगा, जब तक कि उक्त 15 दिनों की अवधि के भीतर इसे शिक्षा निदेशक (Director of Education) को संसूचित न किया गया हो और शिक्षा निदेशक द्वारा इसका अनुमोदन प्रदान न कर दिया गया हो। यदि शिक्षा निदेशक 15 दिनों के भीतर अपनी स्वीकृति नहीं देते हैं, तो कर्मचारी स्वतः बहाल माना जाता है और वह पूर्ण वेतन व भत्तों का हकदार होता है।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (A) 15 days

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: Under Rule 115 of the Delhi School Education Rules 1973, the Managing Committee of a recognized private school can place an employee under suspension for a maximum period of fifteen days without prior approval of the Director of Education. Extending suspension beyond fifteen days requires explicit administrative approval from the Director.

questions.question_english: A statutory audit party raises an audit objection against a Delhi Government school regarding the improper maintenance or absence of a vehicle logbook for the school bus. Under Delhi School Education Rules (DSEAR) 1973 and financial rules, who bears ultimate administrative and financial responsibility to ensure the logbook is duly maintained and presented during audit inspection?
options_english: The School Management Committee (SMC) Chairperson
The assigned departmental bus driver
The Zonal Education Officer (ZEO)
The Head of School / Drawing and Disbursing Officer (DDO)
questions.explanation_english: Under Rule 43 and Rule 59 of the Delhi School Education Act and Rules (DSEAR), 1973, read with the Central Government Account (Receipts and Payments) Rules and General Financial Rules (GFR), the Head of School (HoS) functions as the Drawing and Disbursing Officer (DDO) and Head of Office (HoO). The HoS carries comprehensive statutory and pecuniary responsibility for the administration of institutional assets, vehicle fleet management, fuel consumption registers, and official logbooks. While the driver is physically responsible for recording individual odometer readings and trips, the legal and administrative onus to enforce, supervise, attest, and submit audited vehicle logbooks to statutory audit authorities rests solely with the Head of School / DDO.
questions.explanation_hindi: दिल्ली स्कूल शिक्षा अधिनियम एवं नियमावली (DSEAR), 1973 तथा सामान्य वित्तीय नियमों (GFR) के अनुसार, विद्यालय प्रमुख (Head of School) ही आहरण एवं संवितरण अधिकारी (DDO) तथा कार्यालय प्रमुख (HoO) के रूप में कार्य करता है। संस्थान की संपत्ति, वाहन प्रबंधन, ईंधन खपत और आधिकारिक लॉगबुक के विधिवत संधारण व पर्यवेक्षण की संपूर्ण प्रशासनिक एवं वित्तीय जवाबदेही विद्यालय प्रमुख/DDO की होती है। यद्यपि दैनिक फेरों व ओडोमीटर रीडिंग को दर्ज करना चालक का तकनीकी कार्य है, किंतु लॉगबुक के नियमित सत्यापन, सुरक्षा और लेखापरीक्षा (ऑडिट) के समक्ष प्रस्तुत करने का वैधानिक दायित्व विद्यालय प्रमुख का होता है।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (D) The Head of School / DDO

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: The Head of School, acting as the Drawing and Disbursing Officer, holds primary administrative and financial responsibility for institutional operations. Ensuring that all official vehicles, including school buses, maintain updated logbooks detailing trips, fuel usage, and maintenance for audit inspection falls directly within the official duties of the Head of School.

questions.question_english: How is the 'Distance Criteria' under neighbourhood guidelines practically calculated and verified during the centralized online admission process in Delhi schools?
options_english: Physical distance measurement conducted on-site using standard measuring tape surveys by school staff.
Automated mapping of residential GPS coordinates to the school location using an online Geographic Information System (GIS).
Voluntary submission of a notarized distance self-declaration affidavit executed by the applicant's parent.
Physical distance verification and certification issued directly by the local postal department.
questions.explanation_english:
Under the Right to Education rules and the Delhi Directorate of Education's automated admission module (for both Non-Plan admissions in government schools and EWS/DG/Freeship admissions in private schools), the neighbourhood criterion is operationalized through modern digital technology.

Operational Mechanism of Distance Calculation:
1. Automated GIS Mapping: The centralized portal incorporates a Geographic Information System (GIS) engine integrated with spatial mapping (such as Google Maps API / Delhi GIS data). When the applicant selects their residential locality, PIN code, and house address, the system automatically computes the aerial / spatial road distance to all candidate schools in the cluster.
2. Elimination of Discretion and Malpractice: Previously, manual affidavits or physical surveys led to manipulation, disputes, and subjective bias. The online GIS system assigns students objectively to neighbourhood distance slabs:
   - 0 to 1 km (First priority under neighbourhood criteria),

questions.question_english: Under Rule 13 of the CCS (Conduct) Rules, 1964, a government servant must obtain prior sanction or report the acceptance of gifts exceeding prescribed monetary thresholds. What fundamental administrative principle underpins this requirement?
options_english: To prevent deliberate personal income tax evasion and undisclosed liabilities
To discourage informal socialization and personal obligations among public personnel
To maintain absolute integrity and avoid conflict of interest in official functioning
To strictly monitor and regulate the private domestic expenditure of civil servants
questions.explanation_english:
Rule 13 of the Central Civil Services (Conduct) Rules, 1964 specifically regulates the acceptance of gifts by government servants. The overarching objective of this rule is anchored in Rule 3(1)(i) and Rule 3(1)(ii), which require every government servant to maintain absolute integrity, devotion to duty, and avoid any act unbecoming of a government servant.

Key Administrative Dimensions:
1. Conflict of Interest: Unregulated acceptance of lavish gifts creates personal indebtedness, compromises administrative impartiality, and exposes public officials to external influence from contractors, suppliers, parents, or commercial entities.
2. Prescribed Limits: A government servant may accept customary gifts from near relatives or personal friends on occasions such as weddings or anniversaries, but must report or obtain prior government sanction if the value exceeds thresholds specified by DoPT amendments (e.g., Rs. 5,000 for Group 'A' officers for customary gifts, and strictly nominal limits for non-relatives/official dealings).
3. Pure Integrity: The underlying intent is not tax auditing or personal expenditure tracking, but insulating public office from corruption and unethical obligations. Thus, Option C is correct.
questions.explanation_hindi:

महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक आयाम:
1. हितों का टकराव (Conflict of Interest): यदि लोक सेवक मूल्यवान उपहार बिना रोक-टोक स्वीकार करेंगे, तो इससे निजी पक्षकारों, ठेकेदारों अथवा हितधारकों के प्रति अनुचित दायित्व उत्पन्न होगा और निष्पक्ष निर्णय लेने की प्रक्रिया दूषित होगी।
2. विहित सीमाएं: विवाह, वर्षगांठ या धार्मिक उत्सवों जैसे अवसरों पर निकट संबंधियों अथवा निजी मित्रों से प्रथागत उपहार स्वीकार किए जा सकते हैं, परंतु कार्मिक एवं प्रशिक्षण विभाग (DoPT) द्वारा निर्धारित सीमाओं (जैसे ग्रुप 'A' अधिकारियों हेतु निर्धारित मौद्रिक सीमा) से अधिक होने पर सरकार को रिपोर्ट करना अनिवार्य है।
3. शुचिता व पारदर्शिता: इस नियम का उद्देश्य व्यक्तिगत व्यय को नियंत्रित करना नहीं, बल्कि प्रशासनिक तंत्र में भ्रष्टाचार, पक्षपात तथा हितों के टकराव को पूरी तरह रोकना है। अतः विकल्प (C) सही उत्तर है।

questions.question_english:
Consider the following statements regarding 'Leave Not Due' (LND) under the Central Civil Services (Leave) Rules, 1972:
I. It is granted when the employee has no half-pay leave (HPL) at credit.
II. It is granted ordinarily on medical certification.
III. It is debited against the half-pay leave the employee may earn subsequently.
IV. It can be granted up to a maximum limit of 360 days in the entire service.
Which of the above statements is/are correct?
options_english: I and II only
III and IV only
I, II and III only
I, II, III and IV
questions.explanation_english:
Under Rule 31 of the Central Civil Services (Leave) Rules, 1972, 'Leave Not Due' (LND) is an advance leave granted to a permanent or quasi-permanent government employee under strict regulatory conditions:
1. Condition of Zero HPL: It is sanctioned only when no half-pay leave (HPL) is available at the credit of the employee (Statement I is correct).
2. Medical Certification: Except in specified non-medical situations (such as Child Care Leave or specialized training/study), LND is sanctioned strictly upon production of a valid medical certificate issued by an authorized medical attendant, provided the leave sanctioning authority has reasonable belief that the employee will return to duty and earn sufficient leave to offset the debit (Statement II is correct).
3. Subsequent Debiting: The leave so granted is debited against the half-pay leave that the employee will earn subsequently upon resuming duty (Statement III is correct).
4. Maximum Ceiling: The maximum quantum of Leave Not Due that can be sanctioned to an employee across their entire service career is capped at 360 days (Statement IV is correct).
Therefore, all four statements (I, II, III, and IV) are fully correct.
questions.explanation_hindi:
केंद्रीय सिविल सेवा (अवकाश) नियमावली, 1972 के नियम 31 (Rule 31) के अंतर्गत 'अदेय अवकाश' (Leave Not Due - LND) एक अग्रिम अवकाश सुविधा है जो स्थायी अथवा अर्ध-स्थायी सरकारी कर्मचारियों को निम्नलिखित शर्तों के अधीन प्रदान की जाती है:
1. शून्य अर्ध-वेतन अवकाश: यह केवल तभी स्वीकृत किया जाता है जब कर्मचारी के अवकाश खाते में कोई अर्ध-वेतन अवकाश (HPL) शेष न हो (कथन I सही है)।
2. चिकित्सा प्रमाण-पत्र: विशेष परिस्थितियों (जैसे चाइल्ड केयर अथवा अध्ययन अवकाश) को छोड़कर, LND सामान्यतः अधिकृत चिकित्सा प्रमाण-पत्र प्रस्तुत करने पर ही स्वीकृत किया जाता है, जब सक्षम प्राधिकारी संतुष्ट हो कि कर्मचारी के सेवा में लौटने और भविष्य में समतुल्य अवकाश अर्जित करने की पूरी संभावना है (कथन II सही है)।
3. भविष्य के अवकाश से समायोजन: स्वीकृत अदेय अवकाश को कर्मचारी द्वारा भविष्य में ड्यूटी पर लौटने के उपरांत अर्जित किए जाने वाले अर्ध-वेतन अवकाश से नामे (डेबिट) किया जाता है (कथन III सही है)।
4. अधिकतम सीमा: संपूर्ण सेवाकाल में अदेय अवकाश की अधिकतम संचयी सीमा 360 दिन निर्धारित की गई है (कथन IV सही है)।
अतः सभी चारों कथन (I, II, III और IV) पूर्णतः सत्य हैं।

questions.question_english: Under Rule 8 of the Central Civil Services (CCS) Conduct Rules, 1964, a government servant generally requires prior sanction of the Government before publishing a book. What is the statutory exception provided to this restriction?
options_english: If the publication is authored entirely under a strictly anonymous pseudonym
If the literary content offers constructive, analytical criticism of official government policy
If the book is purely literary, artistic, or scientific in character
If the book is brought out exclusively by an overseas international academic publisher
questions.explanation_english: Rule 8(2) of the CCS (Conduct) Rules, 1964 provides that no government servant shall, except with the previous sanction of the Government or of the prescribed authority, or in the bona fide discharge of their duties, publish a book or edit or manage or conduct or participate in a publication. However, the proviso to Rule 8(2) explicitly creates an exception: no such sanction shall be required if such publication is of a purely literary, artistic, or scientific character. Even in such cases, the government servant must ensure that the work does not violate Rule 9 (adverse criticism of Government policy, action, or embarrassment of relations between Central and State/foreign governments) or disclose classified official information obtained during service.
questions.explanation_hindi: CCS (आचरण) नियम, 1964 के नियम 8(2) के अनुसार कोई भी सरकारी कर्मचारी सरकार या निर्धारित प्राधिकारी की पूर्व स्वीकृति के बिना किसी पुस्तक का प्रकाशन, संपादन अथवा प्रबंधन नहीं कर सकता। परंतु इस नियम का परंतुक (proviso) एक स्पष्ट अपवाद प्रदान करता है कि यदि कोई कृति अथवा पुस्तक पूर्णतः 'साहित्यिक, कलात्मक या वैज्ञानिक' (purely literary, artistic, or scientific) स्वरूप की है, तो इसके प्रकाशन के लिए सरकार की पूर्व स्वीकृति की आवश्यकता नहीं होती है। बशर्ते कि उस कृति में नियम 9 का उल्लंघन न हो (सरकारी नीतियों की तीखी आलोचना या गोपनीयता का उल्लंघन न हो)।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (C) If the book is purely literary, artistic, or scientific in character

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: Central Civil Services Conduct Rules require prior sanction before publishing books, but make an explicit exception for works that are purely literary, artistic, or scientific in nature. Government employees can publish such creative or academic works without advance approval, provided the material does not touch upon sensitive official government policies or administrative matters.

questions.question_english: Under the definitions and statutory framework of the Delhi School Education Act and Rules (DSEAR), 1973, what constitutes an 'unaided minority school'?
options_english: A public primary school established and directly administered by the local municipal body
An international educational institution founded and operated exclusively by diplomatic missions
A designated institution required to admit students strictly belonging to a minority community only
A recognized school established and administered by a religious or linguistic minority community that receives no aid or grant from the Government or local authority
questions.explanation_english: Under Section 2(x) read with Section 2(o) of the Delhi School Education Act, 1973 (DSEA 1973), an 'unaided minority school' is defined as a recognized school established and administered by a minority community, whether based on religion or language, having the right to do so under clause (1) of Article 30 of the Constitution of India, and which does not receive any grant-in-aid or financial assistance out of the Consolidated Fund of the State or from any local authority. While such schools are recognized by the Directorate of Education and subject to health, safety, and basic academic standards under DSEAR 1973, they enjoy constitutional protection regarding their internal management, staff appointment, and are also exempt from the 25% EWS/DG quota mandate under Section 12(1)(c) of the RTE Act 2009 pursuant to Supreme Court rulings (e.g., Pramati Educational Trust case). Hence, option D correctly defines an unaided minority school.
questions.explanation_hindi: दिल्ली स्कूल शिक्षा अधिनियम, 1973 (DSEA 1973) की धारा 2(x) तथा धारा 2(o) के अनुसार, 'गैर-सहायता प्राप्त अल्पसंख्यक विद्यालय' का आशय ऐसे मान्यता प्राप्त विद्यालय से है जो भारतीय संविधान के अनुच्छेद 30(1) के तहत किसी धार्मिक या भाषाई अल्पसंख्यक समुदाय द्वारा स्थापित एवं प्रशासित किया गया हो, तथा जो सरकार या किसी स्थानीय प्राधिकरण से कोई सहायता अनुदान (Grant-in-aid) प्राप्त नहीं करता हो। यद्यपि ऐसे विद्यालय शिक्षा निदेशालय से मान्यता प्राप्त होते हैं और उन पर DSEAR 1973 के शैक्षणिक व सुरक्षा मानक लागू होते हैं, फिर भी उन्हें अपने आंतरिक प्रबंधन में स्वायत्तता प्राप्त होती है और माननीय सर्वोच्च न्यायालय (प्रमति एजुकेशनल ट्रस्ट वाद) के निर्णय के अनुसार वे RTE अधिनियम की धारा 12(1)(c) के तहत 25% EWS कोटे से भी मुक्त हैं। अतः विकल्प D सही उत्तर है।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (D) Recognized minority school receiving no state grant, managed by a minority community

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: Under the Delhi School Education Act 1973, an unaided minority school refers to a recognized educational institution managed by a religious or linguistic minority community that receives no financial aid or grants from the state government. Such institutions retain autonomy over internal administration while adhering to core statutory regulations.

questions.question_english: In Delhi private unaided recognized schools conducting entry-level admissions under the point-based Open/General Category criteria, what is the standard administrative procedure for verifying a parent's claim for points under the 'Sibling Quota'?
options_english: Requiring mandatory DNA genetic profiling tests of both children conducted at a government forensic laboratory
Mandating the submission of an endorsement certificate attested by the local Member of Legislative Assembly (MLA)
Cross-verifying the real sibling's current tuition fee receipt, student identity card, and active admission number from internal school records
Initiating a formal police verification inquiry regarding family background through the local station house officer
questions.explanation_english: Under the admission criteria guidelines issued by the Directorate of Education (DoE), Delhi, for entry-level admissions in private unaided recognized schools, schools formulate fair, reasonable, and transparent criteria, among which 'Sibling' is a widely recognized and approved criterion carrying points. Sibling points are strictly meant for real brothers and sisters studying in the same school. To verify this claim, the school admission committee cross-checks internal school records: verifying the student's admission number, current academic session tuition fee slip, school identity card, and student cumulative record in the school database. Unreasonable demands or external political affidavits are invalid. Hence, checking internal school admission records and current fee receipts is the prescribed, legitimate verification procedure.
questions.explanation_hindi: शिक्षा निदेशालय (DoE), दिल्ली द्वारा निजी गैर-सहायता प्राप्त विद्यालयों में प्रवेश स्तर (नर्सरी/केजी/कक्षा 1) की खुली सीटों पर प्रवेश के लिए जारी दिशा-निर्देशों के तहत 'सहोदर/भाई-बहन' (Sibling) मानदंड एक वैध एवं व्यापक रूप से स्वीकृत मानदंड है जिसके लिए अंक आवंटित किए जाते हैं। यह अंक केवल उसी विद्यालय में वर्तमान में अध्ययनरत सगे भाई या बहन के लिए देय होते हैं। इस दावे की पुष्टि के लिए विद्यालय की प्रवेश समिति अपने आंतरिक अभिलेखों से वास्तविक मिलान करती है—जिसमें अध्ययनरत भाई/बहन की नवीनतम शुल्क रसीद (Fee Slip), विद्यालय पहचान पत्र, सक्रिय प्रवेश संख्या (Admission Number) तथा छात्र पंजिका की जांच की जाती है। किसी बाहरी राजनीतिक हलफनामे या पुलिस जांच की आवश्यकता नहीं होती। अतः विकल्प C सही प्रक्रिया को दर्शाता है।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (C) Verifying current fee receipt, student ID, and admission number in school records

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: To verify sibling quota claims during entry-level private school admissions, the school management checks internal student records. Verification involves examining current tuition fee receipts, student identity cards, and active admission numbers of the real sibling currently enrolled in the school, ensuring genuine qualification for preference points allotted under guidelines.
